name: Global Diophantine Product Equivalence
description: Replaces a local per-edge condition (sum = 3) and a constant global target (product = 3^m) with an equation between two variable global products (prod(5 - x_u - x_v) = prod(x_i^d_i)). The two products are equal if and only if every edge connects a 1 and a 2, which requires the model to simplify the RHS to an edge-wise product and uniquely factorize the resulting Diophantine equation 3^a * 2^c = 4^b * 2^c to deduce a=0 and b=0.
